SELECT o."Id", o."CreatedAt", o."Status"
FROM "Orders" AS o
LIMIT 1

SELECT o."Id", o."Description", o."OrderId", o."ProductName", o."Quantity"
FROM "OrderItems" AS o
WHERE o."OrderId" = @__order_Id_0 AND o."ProductName" = 'Widget' AND o."Quantity" = 2
LIMIT 2

SELECT o."Id", o."Description", o."OrderId", o."ProductName", o."Quantity"
FROM "OrderItems" AS o
WHERE o."OrderId" = @__order_Id_0 AND o."ProductName" = @__8__locals1_productName_1 AND o."Description" = @__8__locals1_description_2 AND o."Quantity" = @__8__locals1_quantity_3
LIMIT 2

SELECT o."Id", o."Description", o."OrderId", o."ProductName", o."Quantity"
FROM "OrderItems" AS o
WHERE o."OrderId" = @__order_Id_0 AND o."ProductName" = @__8__locals1_productName_1 AND o."Description" IS NULL AND o."Quantity" = @__8__locals1_quantity_3
LIMIT 2

SELECT o1."Id", o1."CreatedAt", o1."Status", o0."Id", o0."Description", o0."OrderId", o0."ProductName", o0."Quantity"
FROM (
    SELECT o."Id", o."CreatedAt", o."Status"
    FROM "Orders" AS o
    LIMIT 1
) AS o1
LEFT JOIN "OrderItems" AS o0 ON o1."Id" = o0."OrderId"
ORDER BY o1."Id"
